Recode columns having specific modalities

Source: R/factor.R
recode_col_w_levels.Rd

Spot columns having a specific set of levels using keep_col_w_levels, and recode them using the order of the levels in the levels argument.

Usage

recode_col_w_levels(data, levels, labels = levels, ignore_case = FALSE)

Arguments

data

input dataset

levels

complete set of specific levels seeked for the variables

labels

either an optional character vector of labels for the levels (in the same order as levels after removing those in exclude), or a character string of length 1. Duplicated values in labels can be used to map different values of x to the same factor level.

ignore_case

Should case differences be ignored in the match? For fixed(), this uses a simple algorithm which assumes a one-to-one mapping between upper and lower case letters.

Value

data with the same properties as the input data, with the columns having all the levels specified in the levels argument recoded

Examples

data.frame(
x = c("Non", "Oui", "Non", "Oui", "Oui", NA_character_),
y = c("N", "O", "Non", "Oui", "Oui", NA_character_),
z = c("Non", "Oui", "Non", "Oui", "+", NA_character_)
) %>%
  recode_col_w_levels(levels = c("Non", "Oui"))
#>      x    y    z
#> 1  Non    N  Non
#> 2  Oui    O  Oui
#> 3  Non  Non  Non
#> 4  Oui  Oui  Oui
#> 5  Oui  Oui    +
#> 6 <NA> <NA> <NA>
data.frame(
x = c("Non", "Oui", "Non", "Oui", "Oui", NA_character_),
y = c("N", "O", "Non", "Oui", "Oui", NA_character_),
z = c("Non", "Oui", "Non", "Oui", "+", NA_character_)
) %>%
  recode_col_w_levels(levels = c("Non", "Oui"), labels = c("N", "O"))
#>      x    y    z
#> 1    N    N  Non
#> 2    O    O  Oui
#> 3    N  Non  Non
#> 4    O  Oui  Oui
#> 5    O  Oui    +
#> 6 <NA> <NA> <NA>
# Recode the dataset even for columns with case issues in the factors
data.frame(
  id = 1:4,
  dummy = c(0, 0, 1, 1),
  DB = c("oui", "non", "non", "oui"),
  typo = c("oui", "non", "non", "pui"),
  case = c("OUI", "Non", "non", "oui"),
  sexe = c("F", "H", "F", "H"),
  regex_spec = c("+", "-", "-", "+"),
  DB_w_na = c("oui", "non", "non", NA_character_),
  na_only = rep(NA_character_, times = 4)
) %>%
recode_col_w_levels(levels = c("non", "oui"), ignore_case = TRUE)
#>   id dummy  DB typo case sexe regex_spec DB_w_na na_only
#> 1  1     0 oui  oui  oui    F          +     oui    <NA>
#> 2  2     0 non  non  non    H          -     non    <NA>
#> 3  3     1 non  non  non    F          -     non    <NA>
#> 4  4     1 oui  pui  oui    H          +    <NA>    <NA>
if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
recoded_data <- recode_col_w_levels(data, levels = c("non", "oui"))
recode_col_N_O <- partial(.f = recode_col_w_levels, levels = c("N", "O"))
} # }
